items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So, did you say that you knew Hippolyte Charles? Yeah, very well. Did you play in the Silverleaf Band with him or before him or after him? [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, that was after him... But Albert Baptiste had it when I was, uh, playing with him.

ctx.x: He had Silverleaf Band and Hippolyte Charles played with him. Now let's see, Arthur Williams. And this girl, I think, let me say before I forget about that, they call her Sweet Emma. Yeah. But I think she was playing with the Silverleaf one time, Hippolyte Charles was playing. Oh, Emma Farris.
